subject: design/argus-agent-v1
statement: Argus's behavior is a **guide-bound drive protocol** — vendor-neutral, requiring only sequential agentic execution, file access, and a shell — executed per problem in **one preferred continuous session** (design-brainstorm:argus-tech-design#D-6): orient on the problem ledger and repo; loop the pipeline stages **by role** against the pipeline map, entering each as decision principal under its landed seam; at every gap run the **legality tests** (tier · channel · regression) and rule by recorded assumption or escalate the breaking residue as a self-contained brief that **parks the problem fail-closed and ends the session** (#D-7); bridge the approved plan through the planning stage's own materialization; drive proposals to **content-verified landed**; close the journal once. Continuity is the sibling design's journal, animated here by the **resume protocol** — replay, then verify every pending external effect against its goal object before any redo (#D-2). Every act that decides or permits passes a **grant check against the ladder at act time**; the never-list needs no *grant* check — the protocol contains no path that performs self-grant, governance authoring, or override acts — **with one exception that binds by measurement, not by path: the envelope**, which §3.2's envelope watch implements (driving itself spends). The harness (#D-9) proves the zero-tolerance families red-first before the floor grant is exercised.
